Fuller sound in calls with someone who has this on too; the call screen then shows HD. Uses about a quarter more data.
Lifts a quiet voice in a call to a normal level. Without it, Louder on the call screen lifts one person\'s voice, and is remembered for them.
Your microphone goes through WebRTC\'s echo cancellation, noise suppression and volume instead of the phone\'s own. Try it if people hear an echo or you sound too quiet. From the next call.
Let others know when you\'ve read their messages. Works both ways: with this off you won\'t see when they read yours.
Block screenshots and app switcher preview

When a contact also has this on, call audio and files go straight between your phones instead of through the relay: better sound, less relay data, but each of you can see the other\'s IP addresses (internet, home network and mobile). Calls and files with people who aren\'t your contacts always use the relay.
No send animation; backgrounds and the call screen stay still. Also on while Android\'s “Remove animations” is.
